<script type="text/javascript">
            Sepoa.cache.text.load({
                url:CONTEXT_NAME+'/resource/plugin/sepoasoft/screenbuilder/langs/'+Sepoa.info.LANGUAGE+'.js',
                def:CONTEXT_NAME+'/resource/plugin/sepoasoft/screenbuilder/langs/KO.js'
            });
		</script>
    
        <script src="<%=CONTEXT_NAME%>/resource/plugin/sepoasoft/screenbuilder/screenbuilder.js" type="text/javascript"></script>
        <script src="<%=CONTEXT_NAME%>/resource/plugin/sepoasoft/screenbuilder/sepoauxmockup.js" type="text/javascript"></script>
        <script src="<%=CONTEXT_NAME%>/resource/plugin/sepoasoft/history/history.js" type="text/javascript"></script>
        <link href="<%=CONTEXT_NAME%>/resource/plugin/sepoasoft/screenbuilder/css/screenbuilder.css" rel="stylesheet" type="text/css" />
        
        <script type="text/javascript">
        (function(){
            var a = [];
			var p = "<%= CommonUtil.getConfig("sepoa.module.priority","FRWK") %>".split(",");
            for(var i in p){
                a.push({text:p[i], value:p[i]})
            }
            window.formModuleOption = a;
        })()
        </script>
